what: On a fixed plate behind the page, a few colored shapes (rounded blob · circle · pentagon) scatter anywhere on screen (up to 100px outside the edge) at .9~1.1x size each time the page opens, and every 10 seconds one random shape fades out over .3s and comes back on over .3s at another spot and size. They do not glide, so the background stays quiet, and they stay fixed to the screen on scroll so text passes over the shapes

options.every: Interval for moving one item (s), default 10
options.margin: Distance in px it may stick out past the screen, default 100
options.[data-fx-part=shape]: Shape to move (child) — size and form are set by the consumer’s css/svg

note: Random on every open, so the original and the copy can never sit in the same spot. The panel is pointer-events: none so it does not cover the links below

from.where: recruit.html .fr-shapes (four colored shapes behind the recruit hero — original .recrtFvBlock .imgLoop img: position fixed, position random×(vw+200)−100, scale .9~1.1, every 10000ms one goes opacity 0 → new position after 300ms)
